grains.RAW.MACHINES: one physical machine per ID; 20 synthetic machines with HASH-seeded age, category, reliability, shift and PM profile
grains.RAW.SENSOR_READINGS: one machine-day per ENTITY_ID and EVENT_DATE; daily aggregates, not individual sensor packets
grains.RAW.SPARE_PARTS: one required spare-part type per machine at snapshot date
grains.CURATED.PERFORMANCE_SUMMARY: one machine over the entire 90-day observation window
grains.CURATED.TREND_ANALYSIS: one day over the equipment fleet
grains.ML.FAILURE_RISK_SCORES: one machine scored on its latest observation day
grains.RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY: one IoT Core message (simulated sensor reading) loaded by Snowpipe
grains.ML.VIBRATION_ANOMALIES: one machine-day in the last 15 days, scored against the prior 75-day baseline

mtbf_hours.zero_failures: null; not an infinite or zero MTBF estimate

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation
required_capabilities.remaining_useful_life_model: REPLACED by 7-day failure-risk classifier (no run-to-failure history); out-of-time holdout precision 0.60 / recall 0.53 vs 0.38 base rate
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day fleet downtime FORECAST; vibration ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15; 25 of 320 machine-days flagged)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.MAINTENANCE_SOP_SEARCH over 14 synthetic SOPs (one per equipment class and failure mode)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: semantic view APP.MAINTENANCE_ANALYTICS (stops by type sum to 181, matching KPI) and Cortex Agent APP.MAINTENANCE_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; action memo by Amazon Bedrock Claude via external-access UDF APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (KPIs, daily uptime, downtime by machine, failure risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
